'''Colossus droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed on [[Iokath]] after the [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]] that created the world went extinct following the [[Iokath Civil War]]. The only remaining self-aware droid on Iokath [[ARIES]] used other droids as his slaves, weaponizing them into combat units regardless of their original purpose. The Colossus droid was developed as a massive war machine dozens of meters tall and capable of wiping out an entire army.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colossus droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as enemies on Iokath.
